note: The Cocos (Keeling) Islands is an external Territory of Australia. Read 2026-10-30 in Australia's income tax law, the compilations in force from 1 October 2026: the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 (s. 960-505(1)) counts the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands as part of Australia in a geographical sense, extending the ordinary meaning to each external Territory but the Antarctic one; the Income Tax Assessment Act 1936 gives Australia the 1997 Act's meaning (s. 6) and is the Act under which the Commissioner issues a tax file number on application (Part VA, ss. 202B and 202BA). So the Islands' people fall under the same income tax law, and the same tax file number, as the rest of Australia, and the game reads that they hold Australia's number, whose terms are Australia's file's. The held file of earlier on 2026-10-30 rested on the Australian Citizenship Act alone; this rests on the tax law's own extension, which that file said wasn't read. Not read: an Australian Taxation Office page on the Territory (ato.gov.au answered 403 that day).

sources.title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 (compilation in force from 1 October 2026), volume 10: section 960-505, Meaning of Australia
sources.said: This Subdivision extends the ordinary meaning of Australia to include each external Territory of Australia (other than the Australian Antarctic Territory) ... (1) Australia , when used in a geographical sense, includes each of the following: (a) Norfolk Island; (b) the Coral Sea Islands Territory; (c) the Territory of Ashmore and Cartier Islands; (d) the Territory of Christmas Island; (e) the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands;

sources.title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1936 (compilation in force from 1 October 2026), volume 1: section 6, definitions
sources.said: Australia has the same meaning as in the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 .

sources.title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1936 (compilation in force from 1 October 2026), volume 3: Part VA, sections 202B and 202BA
sources.said: 202B Application for tax file number (1) A person may apply to the Commissioner for the issue of a tax file number. ... if, on an application for a tax file number, the Commissioner is satisfied that the applicant’s identity has been established, the Commissioner shall issue a tax file number to the applicant.
